item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Cookie (Girl Group) - Do It Again & sampler
item.description:
Hi everyone!

I'm trying to hunt down this track by Cookie circa 2006, called Do It Again, preferably in lossless quality but anything that isn't a YouTube rip would be appreciated.

Discogs link: https://www.discogs.com/release/310...Tq8nLqKNSWfwUMgmzd8L8AxxuCjK952Gbh6T5rb1i93_j

I read on a YouTube comment section that apparently there were other songs by them posted, allegedly coming from a sampler, but I haven't found evidence of those ever existing aside from that comment. If anyone can point me to any other tracks by that group I'd greatly appreciate it too.

Thank you in advance!
